verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail's marketing says users can 'set up automation rules' so mail is handled the way they want, and it offers Zapier (5000+ apps) and an API for event-driven workflows. These are brief one-line claims with no detail on which events act as triggers, which actions rules can take, or how conditions are set. Missing for 10: documentation of the rule triggers, conditions and actions, examples of automated mail-handling workflows, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the rules work.
